user.title: Add a Room Companion panel or knob
user.description: Pick the device. It must already be added through the ESPHome integration.

abort.no_panels: No new Room Companion panel or knob found. Add it with the ESPHome integration first, make sure it is online and runs firmware from 2026-11-27 or later.
abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.

data.base_url: Home Assistant address for the panel

data_description.media_players: The players this panel shows. When a track starts, their lyrics come from LRCLIB once. Players opened on the panel mid-song get theirs when the screen opens.
data_description.lyrics: Look up timed lyrics and send them to the panel when a track starts.
data_description.timeout: How long a notification stays. 0 keeps it until dismissed.
data_description.kde_notifications: Needs KDE for Home Assistant. Notifications removed on the phone are cleared on the panel.
data_description.kde_devices: Only these devices. Leave empty for all.
data_description.base_url: Where the panel reaches Home Assistant, for example http://192.168.1.2:8123. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's local network address.
data_description.glyph_font: Path to a TTF or OTF file on the Home Assistant host, for example /config/fonts/NotoSansSC-Regular.otf. Leave empty to turn off characters drawn by Home Assistant.

allow_actions.title: {panel} cannot use Home Assistant actions
allow_actions.description: The panel controls devices through Home Assistant actions. Open **Settings → Devices & services → ESPHome**, select **Configure** on {panel} and turn on **Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions**.

panel_not_loaded.message: Room Companion panel {panel} is not set up or not loaded.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Shows a message, with an optional picture, in the panel's notification centre. Home Assistant downloads the picture and serves it to the panel at the right size.

image_url.name: Picture address
image_url.description: Address of a picture to show. Optional.

timeout.name: Time
timeout.description: Seconds to show it; 0 keeps it until dismissed. Defaults to the panel's notification time.

dismiss_message.name: Dismiss message
dismiss_message.description: Dismisses the newest message on the panel.

resend_lyrics.name: Send lyrics again
resend_lyrics.description: Sends the lyrics of the panel's media players again.
